title: Ridge Regression
signature: def ridge_regression(X: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray, alpha: float) -> tuple
hints: The bias must not be penalized. Centering X and y removes it from the problem.
On centered data, w solves (Xc^T Xc + alpha I) w = Xc^T yc.
Recover the bias afterwards: b = mean(y) - mean(X, axis=0) @ w.
